result.summary: The home feed is mostly rendered correctly, but one section heading displays a raw localization key instead of user-facing text. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel item and bottom-cut pizza card are expected scroll behavior.

issues.description: The second section heading shows the untranslated localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular right now'). This is a missing/unresolved i18n string exposed to users.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the translation key 'home_feed.popular_title' exists in the active locale's string resources and add a sensible fallback (default language string) so raw keys never render in the UI.
